concept.title: Egypt *as a stage.*
concept.subtitle: Three settings for a CRUSH evening where art, music and a luxury brand meet, with NOYA running every element on the ground.
concept.lead: CRUSH brings brands and artists together, Cartier with Gloria Gaynor, IWC with Jamiroquai, in moments people remember. Egypt offers settings few cities can match. NOYA makes them work on the day.
concept.quote: One evening, built for a brand's closest clients, in a place they have never been hosted before.
concept.why_title: A new chapter for luxury in Egypt.

why.label: Talent
why.text: ICONS. by CRUSH brings the artists and cultural figures. NOYA brings the setting, the hospitality and the logistics.
